::: {#def-self-attention}

#### Self-attention

**Self-attention** is [scaled dot-product attention](#def-attention) whose queries, keys and values all come from the same sequence.
For a sequence of $n$ vectors in $\reals^d$,
the rows of an $n \times d$ matrix $\matr{X}$,
it computes

$$
\matr{Q} = \matr{X} \matr{W}_Q,
\qquad
\matr{K} = \matr{X} \matr{W}_K,
\qquad
\matr{V} = \matr{X} \matr{W}_V,
$$

and returns $\operatorname{Attention}\paren{\matr{Q}, \matr{K}, \matr{V}}$,
where the matrices $\matr{W}_Q$, $\matr{W}_K$ and $\matr{W}_V$,
of size $d \times d_k$, $d \times d_k$ and $d \times d_v$,
are [parameters](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter) learned in training
[@vaswani2017attention, section 3.2.3].
Each position's output is a weighted average over every position of the sequence,
itself included.

:::
